session_1_memories.text: The checkout race condition was caused by concurrent stock decrements without locking.
We fixed it by adding a Redis distributed lock around the stock decrement operation.
Customer ACME Corp is on enterprise plan with custom SSO.
Load testing showed 50ms p99 latency improvement after the fix.
